inventory.estimand: Incremental whole-process raw CPU-cycle demand of shipping_optional, conditional on operational work and the common observers. No CPU seconds, GPU, energy or physical-presentation inference.
forensic_additions: native per-operation frame trace, batching, CSV writer and drain for all three phases
per-callback asynchronous renderer CPU/GPU queries and detailed JSONL write/flush
operational_always_on: collision/readiness checks and required data viewer
edit transaction/revision integrity and fixed-work proxy autosaves
complete synchronous terrain enforcement clocks and whole-frame carry
geometric priority admission and one bounded directional preparation viewer
outside_complete_trial_common_harness: process launch, project import, common scene/UI initialization and one complete warm-up trial
Terminal boundary marker write with process-cycle and wall brackets, conservatively expanding both comparison arms; subsequent marker evidence recording is common batch reporting
bounded between-trial report retention/deep-copy and finite protocol selection; at most 13 trial records; shared boundary interval assembly, terminal evidence retention and exact-rational decisions
batch summary/identity hashing, independent-reader work, return-to-title UI and process exit

protocol.early_stop: At any failed work/counter/I/O/operation guard retain prefix and failed/partial trial, inconclusive and stop. Stop after unresolved null (5 trials), positive (9) or shipping (13).
protocol.positive_dose: Native SHA256 over fixed 4096-byte Z bytes, per real tick. Request ceil(positive A0 complete cycle midpoint/(50*4320)), fixed before B1/B2. Retain ordered process/thread observations, wall brackets, updates and digests. Sum 4320 thread-cycle demand intervals; actual/reference bounds must lie above 1% and at/below 3%, overlap measured positive range whose lower bound is at/above 1%. No sleep, yield, dose adjustment or retry.
protocol.shipping_condition: null and positive controls both pass; otherwise stop without another calibration family
protocol.stop_rule: On overlap, negative attribution, unresolved matching-section drift, invalid controls or missing work/I/O/operation evidence: inconclusive; stop and request an explicit measurement/repetition/threshold policy decision. No automatic reruns or profile matrix.

shipping_optional: callback interval count, sum, maximum and deadline-miss counters
one native/resource snapshot per completed simulation second; at most 72 telemetry rows
bounded shipping summary allocation, serialization, write, flush, close and retained telemetry disposal per trial

declaration.rule: Stop at first failed guard or unresolved null/positive control. No padding, profile matrix or target action.
